dialogue.origin: (こんばんは）
dialogue.content: (Good evening.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: （よろしくお願いいたします。始めても大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.content: (It's a pleasure to speak with you. Is it alright if we begin?)

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。来てくださってありがとうございます。きょうはどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 主人との関係で・・色々悩んでます
dialogue.content: It's about my relationship with my husband... I'm struggling with a lot of things.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、詳しくお聞きしたいので、相談者さんと夫さんのご年齢と相談中なんとお呼びしたらいいか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I see. To better understand, could you please tell me your and your husband's ages, and what you would like me to call you during our session?

dialogue.origin: ゆい　です。私は４５歳、主人は４８歳です
dialogue.content: I'm Yui. I'm 45, and my husband is 48.

dialogue.origin: ゆいさん、教えていただきありがとうございます。どんなことでお悩みですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you, Yui. What are you finding difficult?

dialogue.origin: 主人とは、熟年離婚をしそうと思っていたら、今頃になって、気になる人が現れ、段々その人が好きになり、主人がますます受け付けられなくなり、罪悪感に・・。
dialogue.content: I was already thinking my husband and I might get a 'gray divorce,' but now someone I'm interested in has appeared in my life. I've gradually started to fall for him, and it's making it harder and harder to be with my husband... and I'm feeling a lot of guilt.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか・・・。好きな人がお出来になったんですね・・・。もともと、熟年離婚しようと思われたと言う事は、夫婦関係には何か問題があるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... so you've found someone you like. You mentioned you were already thinking about a gray divorce, so does that mean there were some issues in your marriage to begin with?

dialogue.origin: 主人は無口なタイプで、会話の無い今の状態に困ってないと思います。私が、喋らない主人とは息が詰まって、、、
dialogue.content: My husband is the quiet type, and I don't think our current lack of conversation bothers him. For me, being with someone who doesn't talk feels suffocating...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 心が通ってない
dialogue.content: There's no emotional connection.

dialogue.origin: もう、そんな日々がしんどくて。
dialogue.content: Living like that day after day has become so exhausting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お寂しい気持がだんだんしんどさに代わって行かれたんですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so your feelings of loneliness have gradually turned into exhaustion.

dialogue.origin: はい、一緒に何かをするときに苦しいとも感じてます
dialogue.content: Yes, I even feel distressed when we do things together.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、それは一緒にいて合わせるのに苦労するとかでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is it that being together feels like a struggle to accommodate him?

dialogue.origin: 二人で何かを決めないといけない場面で、ダンマリだったり、不機嫌になったり、顔色に合わせて、私が私らしくなくなっている感じ。笑顔が出ないんですよね
dialogue.content: When we have to decide something together, he'll just go silent or get moody. I find myself trying to read his expression, and I feel like I'm not being myself. I can't even smile genuinely.

dialogue.origin: ダンマリ、不機嫌は主人です
dialogue.content: The silent, moody one is my husband.

dialogue.origin: それは苦しいですね。毎日顔を合わせる相手だけに、私だったとしてもストレスが溜まっていきそうです。
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult. Since he's someone you see every day, I imagine I would feel the stress building up as well.

dialogue.origin: 今日はゆいさんがご自分の望む方向に歩んで行けるように、ご一緒に考えたいと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Today, I'd like us to think together about how you can move toward what you truly want. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 分かりました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんとの関係はどんな風に結論を出すか。
dialogue.content: How would you like to reach a conclusion regarding your relationship with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 私としては
dialogue.content: As for me...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もう終止符を打ちたい。でも、この罪悪感が・・
dialogue.content: I want to put an end to it. But this guilt...

dialogue.origin: それと
dialogue.content: And also...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 主人がダメージを受ける姿が浮かんで、
dialogue.content: I keep imagining how devastated my husband will be,

dialogue.origin: 前に進めない
dialogue.content: and I can't move forward.

dialogue.origin: ダンマリの時、陰気だし、暗いし、鬱？ってくらいだから。
dialogue.content: When he's silent, he's so gloomy and dark, it's like... is he depressed? That's how it feels.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるゆいさんは、とてもやさしい方だと思います。夫さんとの関係をきちんととらえていらっしゃるのは立派です！因みに、気になる方とは今はどんな関係でしょうか？気になるだけ？
dialogue.content: The fact that you think that way shows you're a very kind person. It's admirable that you're facing your relationship with your husband so honestly! By the way, what is your relationship like with this other person? Are you just interested?

dialogue.origin: 凄く心の支えになってくれるんです。はっきり確認できてないけど、八割がた確定です。あちらも、私に主人が居るのを知ってるので。
dialogue.content: He's a great source of emotional support for me. I haven't confirmed it explicitly, but I'm about 80% sure. He knows I have a husband.

dialogue.origin: 確定とは、あちらも思ってくれてる意味で
dialogue.content: 'Sure' as in, I think he feels the same way about me.

dialogue.origin: なので、
dialogue.content: So...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはうれしいお気持ちになられますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel happy.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もし、その人と上手くいかなくても、いいと覚悟した上で
dialogue.content: Even if things don't work out with him, I'm prepared for that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 主人との事を考えてはいるんですが、
dialogue.content: I am trying to think about what to do with my husband, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 可愛そうな姿が目に浮かぶのですね・・・
dialogue.content: You picture him looking pitiful...

dialogue.origin: 夫さんの
dialogue.content: Your husband's.

dialogue.origin: 主人がきっと地獄のような現実を知って、どうなるんだろうと想像すると、罪悪感で。
dialogue.content: When I imagine how my husband will react upon learning this hellish reality, the guilt overwhelms me.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 罪悪感をお感じなのは大人としてゆいさんが、正常な判断力を持っておられる事だと思うのです。感情のままに走られることなく考えていると言う事はなかなかできる事ではありませんから、感心させていただいています。
dialogue.content: I think the fact that you feel this guilt shows that, as an adult, you have sound judgment. It's not easy to think things through without being swept away by emotions, so I'm very impressed.

dialogue.origin: ただ、これからの事は誰も傷つかずと言う事では進まないと言う事もお分かりなので、ますますお辛いのだと思います。
dialogue.content: However, I believe you also understand that you can't move forward from here without hurting anyone, which must make it all the more painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい。順番からいったら、好きな人が出来る前から、嫌気はさしていたけど、今好きな人が居るのは事実で、幸せになりたい、純粋にそう思って、なのに困ってます
dialogue.content: Yes. Chronologically, I was already fed up with him before this new person came along, but it's a fact that I have someone I like now. I want to be happy, I genuinely think that, and yet I'm struggling.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、揺れる気持ちにご自身も疲れを感じておられると思います。
dialogue.content: Of course. I imagine you must feel exhausted by your own wavering feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい、とても。
dialogue.content: Yes, very much so.

dialogue.origin: 眠れていますか？
dialogue.content: Are you sleeping okay?

dialogue.origin: 主人が
dialogue.content: My husband...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 眠れてます
dialogue.content: he's sleeping fine.

dialogue.origin: 良かったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: 鬱や自殺を考えないかとか、そんな人なんですよね
dialogue.content: I worry if he might get depressed or think about suicide... he's that kind of person.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、弱くなると脆い方だと思われるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see—you feel he might be fragile when he's vulnerable.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子様は？
dialogue.content: Do you have any children?

dialogue.origin: もうすぐ大学生でこの家をでます
dialogue.content: Our child is about to go to college and will be leaving home.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、熟年離婚とおっしゃっていたのはお子様の成長を待っていたということなんでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. When you mentioned a gray divorce, was it that you were waiting for your child to grow up?

dialogue.origin: 子は一人です
dialogue.content: We have one child.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夫婦での生活、考えられないです
dialogue.content: I can't imagine a life with just the two of us.

dialogue.origin: 主人の母親も一緒ですが。
dialogue.content: Although, my husband's mother lives with us too.

dialogue.origin: そのタイミング近くでお互い好きだと思える人に巡り合ったのですね。夫さんとの生活がますます考えられないお気持ちはどんどんはっきりしていきそうですね。
dialogue.content: And it was around this time that you met someone you feel a mutual affection with. It seems your feeling that you can't imagine a life with your husband is only becoming clearer.

dialogue.origin: お母様も・・・
dialogue.content: And your mother-in-law...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 主人が母親が嫌いで
dialogue.content: My husband dislikes his mother,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 主人、母親、私の食事の時の三人が多く、主人が母親を嫌い、私が主人を嫌い、空気は陰気で。主人の母親が嫌いな顔を見ると
dialogue.content: Most of the time, it's the three of us for meals—my husband, his mother, and me. My husband dislikes his mother, I dislike my husband, and the atmosphere is just gloomy. When I see the look on his face because he dislikes his mother...

dialogue.origin: 耐えられなくて
dialogue.content: I can't stand it.

dialogue.origin: いっそ、母親と私二人で食べたほうが、はっきり私は言う方なんで
dialogue.content: It would be better if his mother and I just ate alone. I'm the type to speak my mind, so...

dialogue.origin: それは本当に厳しい空間だろうなと想像しています。お辛いですね・・・
dialogue.content: I can only imagine how tense that space must be. That must be so hard for you.

dialogue.origin: 後腐れなくて
dialogue.content: That way there'd be no lingering hard feelings.

dialogue.origin: でも主人は気難しいので
dialogue.content: But my husband is difficult, so...

dialogue.origin: 母親も息子を通り越して私に息子の顔色の訳を聞いてくる
dialogue.content: His mother even bypasses her son and asks me why he's in a mood.

dialogue.origin: でも、二人似てるんですよね
dialogue.content: But the two of them are so similar.

dialogue.origin: ああ、お母様としても空気の悪い感じをひしひし感じていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: Ah, so your mother-in-law also keenly senses the unpleasant atmosphere.

dialogue.origin: お話を伺って思ったのですが、
dialogue.content: After listening to your story, I was thinking,

dialogue.origin: 主人はしゃべらないので。母親はめちゃくちゃしゃべりすぎる方で。
dialogue.content: My husband doesn't talk. His mother talks way too much.

dialogue.origin: でも、それ以外そっくりという。
dialogue.content: But besides that, they're exactly alike.

dialogue.origin: だから、夫さんもお母様とは合わないとお感じなんですね。。。ゆいさんが家庭内の緩衝材になっておられたんですね。
dialogue.content: So that's why your husband feels he doesn't get along with his mother... It seems you've been acting as the buffer in the family.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうなんです。だから私が居無くなったら・・
dialogue.content: Yes. That's right. So if I were gone...

dialogue.origin: 考えてたら私の幸せはここには無い
dialogue.content: When I think about it, my happiness isn't here.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、罪悪感を抱いているゆいさんは大人としてきちんとした価値観をお持ちだし、いろいろな可能性を考えておられる頭のいい方だなと感じています。
dialogue.content: I agree. The fact that you feel guilt shows you have proper values as an adult, and I feel you are a very intelligent person for considering all the different possibilities.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Oh no, not at all. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ただ、これからのゆいさんの人生も今までと同じくらいの時間があります。
dialogue.content: That said, you likely have just as much life ahead of you as you've lived so far.

dialogue.origin: まさに、「ここに私の幸せはあるのか」という問いが、これからの問題を切り抜けるカギになるように思うのです。
dialogue.content: I believe that very question, 'Is my happiness here?' will be the key to getting through the challenges ahead.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここには居場所がないと思うんです
dialogue.content: I feel like I don't have a place here.

dialogue.origin: 現在のご家庭には落ち着きを感じられないのですね。。。
dialogue.content: You don't feel a sense of peace in your current home...

dialogue.origin: 母親が嫌いと無視する割には、
dialogue.content: Even though he says he dislikes his mother and ignores her,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 結局、母親が主導権を離してくれない、主人が離させ切れてない
dialogue.content: In the end, his mother won't let go of control, and he can't make her let go.

dialogue.origin: 母親のいう通りに動くんです
dialogue.content: He does whatever his mother says.

dialogue.origin: いつも立派な椅子が人数分あるのに、
dialogue.content: Even though there are always enough nice chairs for everyone,

dialogue.origin: 私はいつもパイプ椅子
dialogue.content: I'm always on a folding chair.

dialogue.origin: しかも、冷たい
dialogue.content: And it's cold.

dialogue.origin: 親離れ、子離れがうまくいっていないのかもしれませんね。お椅子の事はどうして？意地悪で？
dialogue.content: It sounds like they may not have successfully separated as parent and child. Why is that, about the chair? Is it out of malice?

dialogue.origin: お正月は帰省した娘にこの家の主導権を譲る
dialogue.content: At New Year's, he yields control of the house to his sister who comes home to visit.

dialogue.origin: いえ、意地悪ではないですね
dialogue.content: No, it's not out of malice.

dialogue.origin: 出口に一番近いので、立派な椅子が置かれないだけ。だけど私は
dialogue.content: It's just that my spot is closest to the exit, so a proper chair isn't placed there. But for me...

dialogue.origin: そんな椅子に家族は座らせない
dialogue.content: I wouldn't let my family sit in a chair like that.

dialogue.origin: そういう扱いを受けて傷つかない人はいないと思います。
dialogue.content: I don't think anyone would be unhurt by that kind of treatment.

dialogue.origin: その辺の常識や気遣いは普通に無い人たちかなって
dialogue.content: I guess they're just people who lack that kind of common sense and consideration.

dialogue.origin: 傷つける気持ちが無かったとしても、された方は嫌なものですよね。
dialogue.content: Even if there was no intent to hurt you, it's still unpleasant for the person on the receiving end.

dialogue.origin: ゆいさんと嫁ぎ先の価値観が違っているところで、20数年も頑張ってこられたんですね。。。立派な事だと思います
dialogue.content: You've persevered for over 20 years despite the differences in values between you and your in-laws. I think that's truly admirable.

dialogue.origin: せめて、錆びて破れた椅子は、更新しますよね
dialogue.content: At the very least, you'd replace a rusty, torn chair, right?

dialogue.origin: いろいろなお話をお聞きして思ったのですが、ここから先はゆいさんが「ゆいさんの幸せ」をどこに求めて行こうかと言う事を中心に考えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: After hearing everything you've shared, how about we focus on where you, Yui, want to seek 'your happiness' from now on?

dialogue.origin: 色々ありました。この人たちは気づいていないと思います。
dialogue.content: A lot has happened. I don't think these people even realize.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今すぐに結論を出して、好きな人の元に行くというのはかなりの労力と現実的に片づけなければいけないことがたくさんあるように思うのです。
dialogue.content: I think coming to an immediate conclusion and going to be with the person you like would require a great deal of effort and involve many practical matters that need to be sorted out.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相手の方の気持ちもまだ十分に確認できていない段階のようにわたしには思われます。
dialogue.content: It also seems to me that you're still at a stage where you haven't fully confirmed the other person's feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこで、期間を区切って一つ一つ結論を出すために、離婚や生活を分けるにあたっての問題点を書き出してみてはいかがでしょうか
dialogue.content: So, how about setting a timeframe for yourself and writing down the potential issues involved in a divorce or living separately, so you can work towards a conclusion one step at a time?

dialogue.origin: 問題点？期間？ですか？
dialogue.content: Issues? A time frame?

dialogue.origin: 例えば、3か月間の間に相手の方の気持ちを確かめる
dialogue.content: For example, within three months, confirm how he feels,

dialogue.origin: とか
dialogue.content: or something like that.

dialogue.origin: 相手の気持ちがオッケーだったとしても、罪悪感を感じる必要はないのでしょうか・・
dialogue.content: Even if the other person's feelings are confirmed, is it okay for me not to feel guilty...?

dialogue.origin: 罪悪感は感じてしまうと思います。
dialogue.content: I think you will feel guilty.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、罪悪感を抱きながら夫さんと暮らし、生きていくあと50年の人生はゆいさんにとってどんな時間なのか考えてみることが必要だと思います。
dialogue.content: But I think it's necessary to consider what the next 50 years of your life would be like, living with your husband while holding onto that guilt.

dialogue.origin: どちらが耐えられるかって考えてみるんですね？
dialogue.content: So, I should think about which one is more bearable?

dialogue.origin: どちらが耐えられるというか、間違わないでいただきたいのは、夫さんと今の家庭を続けて行く人生も、好きな人と新しい関係を育んでいく人生も、ゆいさんが幸せで元気に歩んでいける方向を選んでいくことが大切だと思うのです。
dialogue.content: It's less about which is more bearable... what I don't want you to mistake is that whether you choose a life continuing your current family with your husband, or a life nurturing a new relationship with the person you like, the important thing is to choose the path that allows you, Yui, to walk forward happily and energetically.

dialogue.origin: 彼は逃げない人なので、結ばれたら、私の悩みも一緒に乗り越えて行ってくれる人です。つまり、私が元気に歩んでいける方向です。
dialogue.content: He isn't someone who runs away, so if we were together, he's the kind of person who would help me overcome my struggles. In other words, that is the direction where I can walk forward energetically.

dialogue.origin: と、思います。
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！その選択肢が本当にゆいさんの望む方向であれば、
dialogue.content: I see! If that option is truly the direction you desire,

dialogue.origin: 元気に歩んでいける方向！ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: The direction where I can walk forward energetically! Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 離婚やお子様やお母様との感情的な葛藤など、現実的に待っているクリアするべき課題を乗り切って行けると思います！
dialogue.content: then I believe you can overcome the practical challenges that await, such as the divorce and the emotional conflicts with your child and mother-in-law!

dialogue.origin: 大きな離婚って問題が待ってるけど、心が軽くなりました。
dialogue.content: The big problem of divorce is waiting for me, but I feel my heart has become lighter.

dialogue.origin: ゆいさんはとても頭の良い方だから、落ち着いて現実的な問題を考えながら進んで行けると思います。元気に歩むゆいさんの笑顔が見えてくる気がします！
dialogue.content: You are a very intelligent person, Yui, so I believe you can move forward calmly while thinking through the practical issues. I feel like I can already see you smiling as you walk forward with energy!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: タフな課題ですが、乗り越えていきましょう！お力になれることがあれば、またお話聞かせてください！
dialogue.content: It's a tough challenge, but let's work on overcoming it! If there's anything I can do to help, please come and talk to me again!

dialogue.origin: それでは時間が来てしまったようですが、お話足りないことは無いですか？
dialogue.content: It seems we're out of time for today—was there anything else you wanted to talk about?

dialogue.origin: はい、また困ったら来ますね。よろしくお願いします。はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll come again if I'm struggling. Thank you. And yes, I'm okay for now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました！では失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much! I'll let you go now.

dialogue.origin: （ロープレありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

topic.sub: 夫とのコミュニケーション問題
